name: Neymar
profileSummary: Neymar da Silva Santos Júnior, known mononymously as Neymar, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a forward for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Santos. Known for his dribbling, technical ability, passing, and finishing, he is widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time. A goalscorer and playmaker, he is both the all-time top goalscorer (80) and assist provider (59) for the Brazil national team and both the all-time Brazilian top goalscorer (43) and assist provider (33) in the UEFA Champions League. He is one of only five players to have scored 100 goals with three different clubs.
